equationOwner.scope: FAMILIES and payload measurement fields, with requested-zone timestamps and unavailable is_day; does not reuse fixed Florida ingress.

claimLimits: Provider-acquired prayer anchors are distinct from synthetic weather values.
Current records are fresh only relative to the declared historical fixture clock; these are not live weather.
Explicit paused/accelerated browser clocks select the preview/forecast lane and do not replace the independent ordinary1x rain lane.
Top-level response coordinates are copied from the exact request target; they are fixture metadata, not extra provider observation authority.
A route must match latitude/longitude/timezone/units exactly, select a declared quarter-hour snapshot, and fail outside this finite range.
Calendar provider bytes must be selected by exact day/target/method and must not be relabelled.

cases.limits: Synthetic representative weather fields follow the H8 fixture equations, with IANA target times. No actual current weather or climate inference. is_day is unavailable; physical solar geometry owns illumination. Captured prayer responses must be served unchanged for their exact requested day/method/target.
